review_evidence: README states that the project gives a complete Lean formalization of Alpöge s disproof of the uniform-constant Erdős unit-distance conjecture and names the final theorem Erdos.erdos_unit_distance_uniform_constant_false.

Direct inventory found ten Lean files and a dense theorem corpus spanning counting, geometry, primes mod 4, multiquadratic fields, discriminants, ideals, norm fibres, point counts, and the final assembly.
The README records a no-sorry/no-extra-axiom audit and identifies external analytic and algebraic dependencies; all project modules remain useful formal prior art.
summary: Retain the complete machine-checked Erdős unit-distance formalization without source-local exclusions.
